short_description: Pack a trip by context and keep a separate final departure list for items still in use.
description: Pack a trip by context and keep a separate final departure list for items still in use. The settings define a city and a trail packing list as comma-separated items. Wheel browses items. Click toggles packed. Start marks an item for the moment you leave. Hold the wheel switches to the departure-only view, and hold Start switches trips. Each trip keeps its own marks.
changelog: New screen transitions and high-contrast LED previews.
